data.body: [P1] On suspension, `executionExceptionFuture` can complete before the `SuspendExecutionException` unwinds through `runHandler`. Consequently, `onInvocationEnd` may flush telemetry and `execute` may return `PENDING` while this scope remains open and user `finally` blocks are still running. Spans emitted there can miss the flush, and custom scope cleanup may occur after Lambda freezes. Compose suspension finalization with `handlerFuture` completion (without synchronously joining from its worker), and test that scope closure precedes `onInvocationEnd` and `run()` returning.
